name: karma
label: Karma
about: SideFX Karma (CPU and XPU), through husk or Houdini. Settings are namespaced attributes on the RenderSettings prim, as Houdini 20.5's Karma Render Settings writes them (karma:global:, and karma:object: for the defaults every object takes). AOVs follow what it writes too (each RenderVar's format, filter, multi-sampling); those marked unconfirmed were not seen in a Houdini file.

params.name: karma:global:engine
params.label: Engine
params.help: cpu or xpu. husk's --engine overrides it.

params.name: karma:global:imagemode
params.label: Image Mode
params.help: Progressive: the whole image refines at once. Bucket: tile by tile.

params.name: karma:global:samplesperpixel
params.label: Primary Samples
params.help: Camera rays per pixel: anti-aliasing, motion blur and depth of field.

params.name: karma:global:pathtracedsamples
params.label: Path Traced Samples
params.help: Samples for each pixel, with Convergence Mode Path Traced.

params.name: karma:global:convergence_mode
params.label: Convergence Mode
params.help: How Karma decides where to spend samples (Variance, Automatic, Path Traced).

params.name: karma:object:varianceaa_minsamples
params.label: Min Path Samples
params.help: The fewest samples a pixel takes, in Variance mode.

params.name: karma:object:varianceaa_maxsamples
params.label: Max Path Samples
params.help: The most samples a pixel takes, in Variance mode.

params.name: karma:object:varianceaa_thresh
params.label: Noise Level
params.help: The noise below which a pixel is done, in Variance mode.

params.name: karma:global:light_sampling_mode
params.label: Light Sampling
params.help: How lights are chosen for each sample (Light Tree, Uniform).

params.name: karma:global:light_sampling_quality
params.label: Light Sampling Quality
params.help: More samples for lights.

params.name: karma:object:diffuselimit
params.label: Diffuse Limit
params.help: How many times a path may bounce off diffuse surfaces.

params.name: karma:object:reflectlimit
params.label: Reflection Limit
params.help: How many times a path may reflect.

params.name: karma:object:refractlimit
params.label: Refraction Limit
params.help: How many times a path may refract.

params.name: karma:object:volumelimit
params.label: Volume Limit
params.help: How many times a path may scatter in a volume.

params.name: karma:object:ssslimit
params.label: SSS Limit
params.help: How many subsurface scattering bounces a path may take.

params.name: karma:global:colorlimit
params.label: Color Limit
params.help: The brightest a direct sample may be.

params.name: karma:global:colorlimitindirect
params.label: Indirect Color Limit
params.help: The brightest an indirect sample may be: clamps fireflies.

params.name: karma:global:russianroulette_cutoff
params.label: Russian Roulette Cutoff
params.help: The bounce after which paths may be ended at random.

params.name: karma:global:screendoorlimit
params.label: Screendoor Limit
params.help: How many transparent surfaces a ray goes through.

params.name: karma:global:pixelfilter
params.label: Pixel Filter
params.help: The filter samples are combined with (gauss, box…).

params.name: karma:global:pixelfiltersize
params.label: Pixel Filter Size
params.help: The filter's width, in pixels.

params.name: karma:global:bucketsize
params.label: Bucket Size
params.help: Width and height of the tiles the image is rendered in, in pixels.

params.name: karma:global:bucketorder
params.label: Bucket Order
params.help: Where buckets start (Middle, Top…).

params.name: karma:object:xformsamples
params.label: Transform Time Samples
params.help: Transform blur samples, the default for every object.

params.name: karma:object:geosamples
params.label: Geometry Time Samples
params.help: Deformation blur samples, the default for every object.

params.name: karma:global:dicingqualityscale
params.label: Dicing Quality Scale
params.help: How finely subdivision and displaced surfaces are diced.

params.name: karma:global:raybias
params.label: Ray Bias
params.help: How far a ray starts from the surface it leaves.

params.name: karma:global:autoraybias
params.label: Auto Ray Bias
params.help: Work the ray bias out from the scene's size.

params.name: karma:global:cacheratio
params.label: Cache Ratio
params.help: The share of physical memory the unified cache may use.

params.name: karma:global:abortmissingtexture
params.label: Abort on Missing Texture
params.help: Stop the render when a texture is missing.
